item.title: Alex Eala clinches historic first SEA Games gold, caps breakthrough year
item.description: Filipino tennis standout Alex Eala captured her first-ever Southeast Asian Games gold medal after delivering a commanding straight-sets victory over Thailand’s Mananchaya Sawangkaew in the women’s singles final on Thursday, December 18, in Thailand.
